'''Leather pants''' are the [[Leather armor|leather]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], crafted from 7 [[tattered leather]]. Matcha Flavoured renames the vanilla leather leggings; leather armor is the cheapest armor and softens falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 2 armor and have 200 durability, against 75 for the vanilla item. They also add 1 block of safe fall distance, so the full set takes 4 blocks off every fall.

=== Dyeing ===
Like vanilla leather armor, they can be dyed.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[sturdy leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
